jobs.title: Auditor Integrated Management Systems
jobs.reason: This is a technical auditor role for quality/environmental/energy management systems, completely unrelated to the candidate's IR/policy focus. Hard ineligibility triggers on multiple counts: requires a technical bachelor/master degree, minimum 5 years industry experience, and fluent Dutch (candidate has only A1).

jobs.title: Freelance Auditor ISO 14001
jobs.reason: Complete mismatch: this is a technical environmental management auditor role requiring ISO14001 lead auditor certification, a technical engineering background, 5+ years of field experience, and fluent Dutch. Multiple hard ineligibility rules triggered (5+ years required, Dutch fluency required, specialist certification not held).

jobs.title: Lead IATF Auditor - Contractor
jobs.reason: This is an automotive quality assurance auditing role requiring specialist expertise in IATF 16949, AIAG core tools, and OEM-specific automotive manufacturing requirements — entirely unrelated to the candidate's IR/policy background. The role also requires Spanish for the Mexican market and substantial prior auditing experience, neither of which the candidate has.

jobs.title: Tutor - Freelancer
jobs.reason: Freelance tutoring role at a certification/assurance company in Shanghai with no relevance to IR, policy research, intelligence, or OSINT. Likely requires subject-matter expertise in LRQA's training areas (quality/compliance/auditing) and presumably Mandarin for local delivery — none of which align with the candidate's profile.

jobs.title: Customer Service Advisor (6 months)
jobs.reason: This is a customer service / client management role in a commercial assurance business, with no connection to IR, policy research, intelligence, or any of the candidate's target zones. Field is a clear mismatch and the role requires 2-3 years of client management experience in a service industry, which the candidate lacks.

jobs.title: Seafood Auditor - Global (ASC, BAP, MSC COC & MSC)
jobs.reason: Complete mismatch — seafood certification auditing (aquaculture, processing plants, food safety) has no overlap with the candidate's IR, international law, and policy research background. The role requires specialist auditing qualifications and 2+ years of sector-specific experience the candidate does not have.

jobs.title: Nuclear Equipment Surveyor - Contractor
jobs.reason: Complete mismatch — this is a technical nuclear equipment inspection role requiring expertise in welding, materials, heat treatment, NDT, and international engineering standards (ASME, BS EN ISO, RCC-M). The role is also restricted to UK Nationals with security clearance, which the candidate (German national) does not meet. Hard ineligibility on nationality requirement and specialist technical qualifications.
jobs.location: Birmingham, UK (predominantly home-based, office South West England)

jobs.title: Auditor Information Security Netherlands
jobs.reason: This is a technical ISO27001/information security auditor role requiring a technical degree, 4+ years of ICT experience including 2+ years in ISMS, and Dutch language proficiency for the actual work. The candidate has none of these — hard ineligibility on language (Dutch fluency required) and on years of specialised ICT experience.

jobs.title: Contractor
jobs.reason: This is an assurance/assessor contractor role at LRQA in Yokohama, with the posting note indicating it is earmarked for a specific named individual. The field (assurance assessment) is unrelated to the candidate's IR/policy/intelligence targets, and the role likely requires Japanese-language capability and specialist assessor qualifications the candidate lacks.

jobs.title: Global People Lead – Global Business Lines
jobs.reason: This is a senior HR/People leadership role in an enabling function at a sustainability consultancy — entirely outside the candidate's IR/policy/intelligence target zones. It requires specialist HR expertise and leadership experience the candidate does not have.

jobs.title: Lead Auditor Food
jobs.reason: Complete mismatch — food industry auditing requires a food science/technology degree, 5+ years in food production, third-party audit qualifications (IFS, BRC, ISO 22000), and Dutch fluency, none of which the candidate has. Hard ineligibility triggered on language (Dutch required for work, candidate only A1), 5+ years hard experience requirement, and specialist vocational qualifications.

jobs.title: Lecturer, School of Economics and Finance
jobs.reason: This is an academic lecturer position in Economics requiring a coursework Master's in Economics, PhD registration, peer-reviewed publications in Q1/Q2 economics journals, and teaching experience in econometrics/financial modelling using R. The candidate's IR/political science background, lack of economics qualifications, and absence of teaching/PhD registration make this a clear mismatch on field, skills, and seniority.

jobs.title: Associate Strategy Director
jobs.reason: "Associate Director" is a senior title typically requiring substantial professional experience in brand/communications strategy, which the candidate (MSc in progress, only student-assistant roles) does not have. The field — sustainability brand and communications strategy for corporate clients — is also outside the candidate's core policy/IR/intelligence targets.

jobs.title: Senior Researcher (AC07)
jobs.reason: Hard ineligibility — the role explicitly requires a PhD (or Master's with substantial progress towards a PhD), which the candidate (currently MSc) does not hold. The Senior Researcher level, equivalent to Senior Lecturer, also far exceeds the candidate's stage, and the urban governance focus is outside their core IR/security interests.
jobs.salary: Not specified (equivalent to Senior Lecturer level)

jobs.title: Senior Manager: ICT Technology Services (IT06)
jobs.reason: This is a senior IT infrastructure management role requiring 7+ years of ICT experience, 2+ years of management, ITIL/COBIT certification, and specialist expertise in data centres, networks, and hybrid cloud infrastructure — none of which the candidate has. Hard ineligibility on seniority (senior management title with 5+ years hard requirement) and complete field mismatch with IR research.

jobs.title: Institutional Researcher and BI Analyst (AD07)
jobs.reason: Higher education institutional research aligns well with the candidate's work for Prof Kaldewey on HEI trends and their German Rectors Conference experience. However, the role asks for a Master's plus 3 years of work experience including research, and emphasises BI/data warehouse and statistical analytics expertise that the candidate has only at a basic level (SPSS, Excel, Python). Seniority is a stretch but not a hard exclusion.

jobs.title: Lecturer in Medieval Art and Architecture
jobs.reason: This is a specialist lectureship in medieval art and architecture, an entirely different discipline from the candidate's IR/international law background. The role requires an established art historian with a PhD-level research and teaching record in medieval art, which the candidate does not have. Hard ineligibility on seniority (lecturer role requiring proven scholarly track record) and field mismatch.
